page.content:
Shubert house on 50th Street, long home of Cats and later School of Rock and more.

How Winter Garden Theatre connects

  • Work: Cats — Cats ran at the Winter Garden Theatre for eighteen years.
  • Faction: The Shubert Organization — The Winter Garden Theatre is a Shubert house.

What is Winter Garden Theatre?

The Winter Garden Theatre is the large Shubert house on Broadway at 50th Street that hosted Cats for eighteen years and remains a flagship musical barn.

Key threads lead to Cats and The Shubert Organization.
